WITH product_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_product_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
    AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_metrics
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
FROM type_averages

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity contains numeric values (or NULL), so it can be cast to a decimal; products with no order items have a count and share of zero, while their average quantity is NULL and ignored by AVG.
